svg.title: web-01 Schedule board (Agency Web App)
svg.desc: Low-fidelity wireframe of the week schedule board for Harborview Home Care, Lakemont North, week of 2026-09-14, with caregivers as rows, visit blocks whose status is shown by grayscale patterns and labels, and an open compliance-check drawer for a new visit showing one hard block (expired blocking credential) and one warning (travel buffer). Numbered callouts 1 to 11.

g.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
